_about: Known events, entered by hand. An event shows in the Performance against targets card, and as a shaded band on the charts of the measures it lists in 'affects', when its dates fall in the selected period. Measures: active-users, new-accounts, transactions, credential-checks. Leave 'affects' out to show an event on every chart. kind is 'campaign' or 'incident'. Dates are inclusive. Keep these in step with the campaigns and incidents in tools/generate-mock.mjs and the provider incidents in reference.json.
